sources.title: Plant-pollinator networks for three subseasons and six years from Villavicencio Nature Reserve
sources.declared_temporal_grain: three subseasons per year for six years

materialization.consequence: exact byte-for-byte RData identity remains unverified

raw_record_reconstruction.period_rule: externally documented Dryad subseason date boundaries

sources.role: traits phenology abundance and annual interaction covariates
sources.title: Trait matching and phenological overlap increase the spatio-temporal stability and functionality of plant-pollinator interactions

public_mirror_candidate.admission_rule: admit only if materialized SHA-256 equals the published Dryad digest

materialization.route: CONICET institutional mirror resolved from item metadata

freeze_rule: Do not record a raw RData checksum until the exact downloaded bytes have been materialized. Keep RData byte identity separate from the independently reproducible raw-record response reconstruction.
join_rule: Freeze plant and pollinator crosswalks before inspecting the focal rewiring contrasts.
analysis_rule: The exact RData object remains an optional source-identity cross-check. Stage-1 response feasibility may use the checksum-validated public raw Figshare visits plus externally documented subseason boundaries. Neither route supplies independent decision-equivalence classes, and observed binary link states remain detection-sensitive.

acquisition_policy.anonymous_metadata: required for Dryad file IDs, declared sizes and published digests
acquisition_policy.rdata_bytes: materialize only through an authenticated Dryad route or an exact mirror whose SHA-256 matches the published digest
acquisition_policy.raw_record_response_route: allowed independently of RData byte materialization when public raw visit files are checksum-validated and the documented subseason boundaries are frozen
acquisition_policy.no_credential_fallback: retain metadata-only RData status; do not treat missing RData bytes as failure of the raw-record reconstruction
acquisition_policy.rdata_identity_gate: exact RData identity remains UNVERIFIED until SHA-256 2503de5acc2a9c6debed880d5289a51a16c0b2e556d35deeaf3cd200a8c0751b is matched
acquisition_policy.ecological_response_gate: raw-record reconstruction may establish observed-link response feasibility only; detection-standardized ecological rewiring remains a separate identification problem

implementation.workflow_behavior: metadata-first; token-aware; uploads inventory even when bytes are unavailable

next_materialization_gate: Optional source cross-check: materialize exact miele-JAE.RData bytes and verify SHA-256 2503de5acc2a9c6debed880d5289a51a16c0b2e556d35deeaf3cd200a8c0751b. This is no longer required for the independent raw-record response reconstruction and cannot by itself resolve ecological detection bias.
